neighbours.label: Clause-junction tokens (comma, 'but', 'also', 'who') where a new clause or modifier is about to attach to the main clause; weak and broad, mixed with scattered code and format tokens
fire: The committee reviewed every application with care, and for the most part, the winners were chosen by a clear majority.
Visitors came not only to the museum but also to the old harbour, where a small market had opened that week.
A surfer was reported missing near the reef, a man who had paddled out alone before the storm arrived.
If we look past the surface details, the real effect of the policy is far smaller than critics claimed.
Practising old exam papers is helpful, and it can also be useful to plan an answer before you start writing.
The engineers tested the pump for hours, but the pressure never stabilised, which delayed the whole project.
Most farmers in the valley refuse to sell, even though prices have doubled, and many say they never will.
In general routine cases, the treatment is given once daily for a week or two, depending on the state of health.
quiet: The committee reviewed every application on Monday morning and then posted the list of winners on the notice board.
Visitors walked through the museum and the old harbour before lunch, then bought fruit at a small market.
A surfer paddled out alone near the reef before the storm arrived and stayed in the water for an hour.
The report describes the policy in detail across forty pages of tables, charts and short summaries of each section.
Practising old exam papers is helpful for students who want to plan an answer before they start writing.
The engineers tested the pump for several hours and recorded the pressure at ten minute intervals on a sheet.
Most farmers in the valley refuse to sell their land, and the price of wheat has doubled since last spring.
The treatment is given once daily for one week to two weeks in routine cases of poor health.

notes: 10x pilot (concept-maps/tenx, random arm): label and 16 sentences written by a fresh Sonnet 5.5 subagent from a packet (card + all-pole band samples); no probes. An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strongest examples are commas after introductory or parenthetical phrases and conjunctions like but/also/who/and, plus a scatter of code and bibliographic punctuation; only 0.04% of tokens pass 0.3 of max and 1.9% pass 0.1, so the pole is broad and weak. Label is a best guess at a clause-boundary context; near misses use the same topics with plain flow and fewer junctions, though some still contain 'and'.
